about: What scripts/board_fit.js does not count as a fault, and why (MA-240). Each allowance names its board (the end of its mirror path), the fault types, a regular expression on the text and, where it holds only at some sizes or frames, the sizes and a regular expression on the frame's label. An allowance that matches nothing is reported, so the list stays true. Change a board to fix a fault; add an allowance only for what is drawn on purpose, with its reason.

superseded.why: The Telegram and Mini App boards and the first Prototype are the superseded record (MA-161): nothing is built from them. PrototypeV4Chat, Pages, Phone and Web are the parts Prototype v4 mounts; the gate walks them inside it. Inside a file that mixes them with current boards, a frame whose label starts with Mini App or Telegram is the same record and is left out too.

allow.why: Home's countries are a pager: the India card peeks past the screen's edge on purpose, so a swipe is plain; what peeks is the next card's start.
The app switcher, drawn as iOS draws it: the cards of other apps sit past the screen's edge.

Foldable · Open and Foldable · Open, Audit draw the chat beside the screen at 880, where the plan's size classes put it in a sheet; at 700 and 744 the screen column is too narrow. MA-242 redraws both boards to the plan and removes this allowance. The iPad frames on the same file are measured in full.
